intro: Hello, little light. I'll walk this path with you.
This valley is full of fog. Some of it lives inside us.
Walk with me. The clearing is just ahead.
controlsMove: Use W A S D or the arrow keys to walk.
controlsMoveTouch: Drag on the left side to walk.
firstBlockade: Look. This fog carries a heavy thought.
breathingTip: Breathe in… let your light grow. Breathe out… let it flow.
breathingKeys: Hold Space to breathe in. Hold Shift to breathe out.
breathingKeysTouch: Hold the light button to breathe in. Let go to breathe out.
released: Softly. That is how it works.
hintStart: Look, the path opens to the clearing.
hintWell: The old well remembers every wish. Rest here a moment.
hintOak: This oak has seen many travellers. It saw them find their way.
hintForest: Two fogs live in this forest. Take your time.
hintRuins: Old stones, old fears. Breathe slowly here.
hintRiver: Listen to the water. It never forces its way.
hintFord: The stones will carry you across.
hintHiddenPath: Breathe in while you walk. Your light shows hidden paths.
hintMonolith: The rune glows for those who breathe.
hintChasmEarly: A bridge of light could cross here. Every fog you release becomes a plank.
bridge: Every fog you released became light. Look.
bridgeMore: Almost. The bridge needs a little more light.
bridgeReady: The bridge is ready. Walk across. I'm with you.
gateOpen: The gate is open. Walk through when you are ready.
chapterEnd: You carried your light through the fog.
startPrompt: Press any key or tap to begin
valleyIntro: Hello, little light. I'll walk this path with you.
Follow the path through the valley, all the way to the chasm.
valleyControls: Use W A S D to walk. Drag with the mouse to look around.
valleyControlsTouch: Drag on the left side to walk. Drag on the right side to look around.
valleyFogFirst: Look. A blockade blocks the bridge.
Try to push it away first.
valleyPushKeysTouch: Tap the hand button to push.
valleyPushed: See? It only grew. Force makes it stronger.
valleyPushedAgain: The harder you push, the darker it gets.
valleyBreathKeys: Hold Space to breathe in. Then hold Shift to breathe out.
valleyBreathKeysTouch: Hold the light button to breathe in. Let go to breathe out.
valleyReleased1: Feel it? The valley is brighter now. And so are you.
The path goes on. Over the bridge.
valleyFogSecond: Another blockade. You know the way now.
valleyReleased2: So much light. You are glowing.
valleyChasmEarly: A bridge of light could cross here. It needs the light of both fogs.
valleyBridge: Every fog you released became light. Look.
valleyBridgeReady: The bridge is ready. Walk across. The arch is waiting.
valleyEnd: You carried your light through the fog.
valleyEndNext: Reload the page to walk it again.
